name: Best Telecom
summary: Gold Coast telemarketing-driven landline/ADSL churner (A.C.N. 127 715 360 PTY LTD, trading as BEST Telecom/BEST Internet/BEST IT from Sep 2007); repeated TIO complaints; ABN cancelled 25 Aug 2017. NOTE: the claim that it was a Wild IT 'phoenix' business is unverified.

events.details: A.C.N. 127 715 360 PTY LTD, Gold Coast QLD; BEST Internet/BEST IT/BEST Telecom trading names registered 25 Sep 2007; earliest Wayback capture 15 Oct 2007.
ABN 18 127 715 360 (A.C.N. 127 715 360 PTY LTD) cancelled 25 Aug 2017; besttelecom.com.au was a parked 'Best Telecom Group - Default Website' by Oct 2020. Retail homepage last live c.2016.
